stem: If the gravitational force between two identical balls of mass 1 kg each, separated by a distance of 1 m between their centers, is calculated, what is the approximate value of this force?
solution_latex: Using Newton's law of gravitation, $F = G \\frac{m_1 m_2}{r^2}$. Given $m_1 = 1$ kg, $m_2 = 1$ kg, and $r = 1$ m. The gravitational constant $G = 6.67 \\times 10^{-11} \\text{ N m}^2 \\text{ kg}^{-2}$. \\\\ Therefore, $F = (6.67 \\times 10^{-11} \\text{ N m}^2 \\text{ kg}^{-2}) \\times \\frac{(1 \\text{ kg})(1 \\text{ kg})}{(1 \\text{ m})^2} = 6.67 \\times 10^{-11} \\text{ N}$.
